lesson:
Think Backwards 💡◀️

Deepinder Goyal - Zomato Founder

For example na channel ki 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali anukondi.. then akkada nunchi backward think cheyyali. 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali ante first chala views kavali. 100 views ki oka subscriber osthunnadu anukondi.. then 10 Million Views kavali 1 Lakh subs kavali ante. So appudu na target viral videos mida undali. 1 Million views.. or 5 lakh views ala oche laga.. then 1 Lakh subs ochestaru

Zero To One Ideas - Peter Thiel

Eppudu kuda solve avvani problems kosam chudandi. Meeru oka product create cheste first adhi meeku chala useful ga undali. Tarvatha adhi mee friends ki chupisthe vallu danni chusi idhi already undi kada nenu ee product/app use chestunna ani cheppe la mee idea undakudadu. Appati varaku vallaki solve avvani problem ni meeru solve cheste appudu mee idea successful ayye chance peruguddi
source: Zero To One by Peter Thiel

lesson:
Viral Feature 🔥

Starting lo product ki fast ga users theeskoche daniki offers ivvadam, discounts ivvadam, cashbacks, referral incentives.. ila cheyyali..
Almost prathi company chestadi adhi. Jio, Paytm, even Elon Musk kuda X.Com pettinappudu chesadu

More Money = More Ownership Stake💲

Starting lo mee sontha money ekkuva pedithe.. tarvatha investors ochina kuda meeku knchm ekkuva stake untadi. Adey ganuka first nunchi funding midey depend aithe mee stake chala thaggipoddi. But indulo mana situation batti povali. First startup ni just experience, network, kosam treat cheste better. Appudu first startup ni ammesthey oche money tho 2nd startup pettandi then you'll have much stake. Elon Musk adey chesadu. Zip2 ammesthey ochina money ni X.com. danni ammesthey ochina money ni SpaceX & Tesla lo..

Funding Technique💰

Airbnb vallaki funding rakapothe… 

🍱 food packets ammi money earn chesi, 

aa ochina money ni valla startup lo pettaru. 🚀

Zip2 Formula 

First meeku oka chinna success kavali. Aa tarvatha inknchm peddadi. Tarvatha inka peddadi. With each success mee confidence, experience, network, reputation anne petuguthai. Starting lo ne maree pedda impractical target pettukovaddu. Elon Musk starting lo ne SpaceX, Tesla lanti companies pettaledu because hardware chala cost, software cheap. Andukani Zip2, Paypal/X.com

Uniform👔
Daily okate type dress eskune laga uniform okati choose cheskondi. It gives u an identity, saves time, simplifies life. Elon Musk biography lo untadi: 

Musk, wearing leather shoes👞, designer jeans👖, and a black T-shirt👕, which is essentially his work uniform.

Strategic Networking🕸️🌐
Elon Musk biography lo idhi chadavandi:

By this time, Musk had built up a decent network of contacts in the space industry, and he brought the best of them together at a series of salons—sometimes at the Renaissance hotel at the Los Angeles airport and sometimes at the Sheraton hotel in Palo Alto. Musk had no formal business plan for these people to debate. He mostly wanted them to help him develop the mice-to-Mars idea or at least to come up with something comparable..

Space related experts tho massive networking chesadu. Andulo kontha mandi Elon Musk ki help chesaru.

Up The Surface Area🌀 - Sam Altman 

Ekkuva sarlu try chese koddi LUCK peruguddi ani chepthadu. Adhi networking lo aithe - ekkuva mandini meet avvandi. Ekkuva books chadavandi. Give up ivvakunda ekkuva rojulu oka dani mida undandi - appudu luck kuda peruguddi. So Startups aney concept mida mee life lo oka 20 years vadalakunda spend cheyyandi.

Core Skills❤️‍🔥 - Sam Altman 
Resilience - entha intelligence unna, experience unna.. Determination.. Kastalu thattukodam.. ivi core blood of success 
Adaptability - 💧
High Rate of Learning - 📚💻👨🏻‍💻
Creativity - 💡
Familiarity with the tools - 👨🏻‍💻🛠️🪚🗜️🧰

Tom Mueller - Outlier Talent 🩸

Meeru SpaceX chapter chadavandi Elon Musk biography by Ashlee Vance lo.. Elon Musk ki space industry lo successful avochu ani confidence eppudu osthadi ante Tom Mueller aney oka elite aerospace engineer close aina tarvatha. Athanu unte chalu manam cheyyochu aney antha confidence osthadi. So excellent talent find out cheyyali. They are like blood🩸 of the company
source: Elon Musk Biography by Ashlee Vance

lesson:
Action👨🏻‍💻 → Clarity🫵🏻

Action theeskune koddi clarity peruguddi em cheyyali em cheyyakudadu edhi work avuddi edhi work avvadu ani. Asalu Elon Musk first SpaceX petti rockets build cheddam anukoledu. Russia lo rockets koni vatini Mars ki pampe laga oka experiment cheddam anukunnadu. Anthey. But Russia vallu adigina price Elon ki nachaledu, thirigi ochestunappudu flight lo Elon Musk ki idea osthadi. Maname rocket build cheyyochu.. ee materials kavali daniki intha cost avuddi ani.. appudu decide avthadu cheap rockets build chese company pedadam ani. So Day 1 lo idea raledu.

🧠Master The Subject

Elon Musk a business related aina andulo main top books anne chadivesthadu.

🚀 Rocket Propulsion Elements
🌌 Fundamentals of Astrodynamics
🔥 Aerothermodynamics of Gas Turbine and Rocket Propulsion
📚 Along with several more seminal texts.
source: Elon Musk Biography by Ashlee Vance

lesson:
Be strong with Numbers 🔢

Elon Musk ki asalu rocket lo motham enni parts untai.. market lo each part cost entha untadi.. ilaga total ga numbers mida command unna tarvatha ardham aindi rocket sonthaga valley build cheyyochu cheap ga ani.

Russia nunchi return flight lo oka spreadsheet lo aa numbers anni calculate chesi chupisthadu

Be Prepared for Rejections 🚫

Adhi Zip2 aina, X.com aina, SpaceX, Tesla.. 🚀

prathi dantlo rejections ochai. ❌

Zip2 lo athe business lu pay cheydaniki oppukoledu.
X.com lo employees vadilesi vellipoyyaru.
SpaceX lo Russians nunchi rejection. 🇷🇺
Tesla lo kuda starting lo cars sale avvaledu. 🚗

Elon Musk aithe Google ki ammeddam anukunnadu company ni.
Tarvatha sales perigai 📈

Iteration 🔄

🚀 SpaceX lo starting valla project oka gas generator create cheyydam.

🧪 Tarvatha danni test cheyyali.

💨 Adhi work aindi but black smoke ochedi.

🔁 Day by day vallu multiple test lu chesaru, improvement tho..

📈 2 Weeks tarvatha adhi sarigga ochindi.

💡 So day 1 lo perfection radu.

⚙️ Chestu poyye koddi success rate peruguddi adhi endulo aina sare.

Embrace Discomfort 🥵

🚀 SpaceX engineers Texas lo engines mida work chesaru.

🐍 Akkada snakes undevi, ants undevi..
🔥 heat chala ekkuva undedi..

⏳ oka 10 days straight akkada work chesi oka weekend ki California ki oche vallu.

✈️ Aa travelling ki konni sarlu Elon Musk thana sontha private jet iche vadu.

🚽 Aa engineers lo okaru toilet mida kurchune vallu because maximum 7 members padatharu aa jet lo!

💪 So antha comfortable ga unte pani chesta ante workout avvadu.

❤️ Love discomfort.

Dating Mindset 💞 - Project Mindset

💡 Startup idea ni maree ekkuva serious ga theesko oddu.

Ante oka idea fix aipoyyi idey na vision idey na dream aney laga. 🎯

❤️ Dating lo mundu oka relationship lo untaru.. adhi workout aithe tarvatha marriage jaruguddi.

🚀 Same startup ideas ni kuda alage chudali. Just projects laga chudandi. Oka project work avvakapothe inko project ki move on aipondi.

Elon Musk kuda alage chesadu. 🚀 Tesla & SpaceX aithe just 10% success chance undi anukunnadu.

📘 Facebook kuda pedda company avuddi ani Mark Zuckerberg anukoledu. Just oka experiment laga chesadu adhi work aipoindi.

🌐 Aa tarvatha Metaverse lo idea mida fix aipoyyi $80 Billion waste chesadu. Adhi flop aindi.

⚡ So either meeru failure ki prepare aipovali.

❤️ Or lekapothe startup idea ni dating laga chudali.

Serial Builder 🔨

Flipkart founder Sachin Bansal..
IIT Delhi lo unde time lo.. life lo first time oka file sharing software build chesadanta.. 💻

Aa software ni anderu pornography share cheydaniki use chesaranta! 😭
Tarvatha management ki adhi thelsi poindi..
Vallu danni theesesaru ❌

Aa tarvatha kuda he created some products 🔨

Elon Musk kuda chinnappude oka game build chesadu 🎮
Mark Zuckerberg facebook ki mundu multiple products build chesadu 💻

So meeru experiment chestu undali useful ayye products gani leka meeku interest undevi gani.. 🧪

adi oka practice laga future Startup ki.. 🚀

fail aina successful aina products build cheyyadam anedi mee identity aipovali.

Become a serial builder. 🔨
source: Big Billion Startup - The Flipkart Story by Mihir Dalal

lesson:
🎯 Start Narrow and then Expand

📚 Amazon, Flipkart - first only books ammaru. Tarvatha verey products add chesaru.

🌍 Spotify vallu first Europe ni target chesi tarvatha America lo enter ayyaru.

⚡ First edhi easy ga fast ga momentum theeskosthado dani mida focus cheyyali.

🚫 Okate sari annee cheyyakudadu.

🚀 Start Early

📊 First Startup pettinappudu

1. 🚀 Elon Musk - Age 24
2. 💻 Mark Zuckerberg - 19
3. 🪟 Bill Gates - 19
4. 🔍 Larry Page (Google) - 19

📈 Majority of successful entrepreneurs early ga start chesaru.

💡 And Sam Altman em chepthadu ante young age lo manaki lose ayye daniki em undadu tarvatha family responsibilities perigipothai so risk early ga theeskodam better..

🎯 Talent Hunting

🧠 Eppudu kuda highly intelligent, talented, skilled people ni meeru attract chestu ne undali. Vallu lekapothe oka below average company avuddi meedi.

🏆 But vallani attract cheyyali ante first mee mida vallaki manchi impression undali.

📈 Adhi ela osthadi ante meeru mundu achieve chesina results ni batti.. mee hard work, commitment.. mee vision.. mee character..

💡 Meeru chala intelligent unte ne vallu meeku attract avtharu. Intelligent avvali ante baga chadavali - technology mida. 📚

🤖 Elon Musk ki Google Founder Larry Page ki multiple times talent hiring mida competition jarigindi.

🧠 DeepMind founder Demis Hassabis kosam.. aa tarvatha inko AI expert Ilya Sutskever hiring lo kuda Elon ki Demis Hassabis ki competition jarigindi.

🔥 So Talented people chala important.

⚡ Fast and Simple

🚀 Mee product use cheyyadaniki chala simple undali and chala fast undali. User ni kastapettakudadu.

📱 For example login page lo direct Gmail tho login aipoyye laga chudali. Ala kakunda valla mobile number, first name second name ala user ki pani penchite user ni lose avvochu.

⚡ And speed matter lo Larry Page.. Google founder aithe.. Google search ni.. patha mobile phones lo check chese vadu.. ante old model phones lo ne chala speed ga work aithe new model phones lo inka smooth untadi experience ani.

🎯 So speed + easy to use

🎨 Design Matters

🚗 Adhi Tesla Car theeskondi 🍎 Apple Products theeskondi 🏠 Airbnb

⚙️ First product functioning chala important. Mundu dani mida work cheyyali.

✨ Dani tarvatha design kuda chala important.

🚀 Launch Fast - No Perfectionism - Lean Startup

💻 Reddit founders first line of code June 4/5th 2005 lo start chesaru..

📅 June 22nd customers ki launch chesesaru.

⚡ So fast ga build chesi launch cheyyali. Dani tarvatha improve cheskuntu povali. Customer feedback ni batti.

💡 Meeru one year build chesina tarvatha daniki asalu demand lekapothe? Motham waste kada...

🚀 So fast ga launch cheste ardham aipoddi... and customers kuda fast ostharu.. feedback fast osthadi.. danni batti modify cheyyadam easy aipoddi.

📊 Avoid Vanity Metrics 🚫

👔 Nenu founder and CEO ani show off cheskodam..

👥 Ma daggara intha mandi employees unnaru ani show off cheskodam..

💰 Lekapothe funding raise cheste danni show off cheskodam..

📈 Valuation show off cheskodam..

🚫 Ilantivi cheyyakudadu.

🎯 Entire focus manam customer ki problem solve chestunnama leda?

🤔 Customer ki maname the best choice aa kada?

💵 Financial ga strong avthunnama leda..

🧠 Talented employees mana daggara unnara leda..

🔥 Ilanti vati mide focus cheyyali.

🗣️ Talk to Customers a Lot

🚀 YCombinator accelerator program lo adey cheptharu... Starting stage lo meeru product build cheyyali. Customers tho matladali. Aa rendey main task lu ani..

💡 Because manam oohinchukunte saripodu customers em anukuntaro thelsukovali.

🎯 Start with the PROBLEM

🏠 Airbnb founders ki idea ela ochindante..

💸 San Francisco lo rent chala ekkuva so vallu afford cheyyalekapoyyaru. Oka room theeskuntaru but valla daggara money thakkuva untadi..

🏨 Ee lopu oka design conference jaruguddi.. akkada chala mandi attend avtharu.. so akkada unde hotels annee book aipothai but inka chala mandiki hotels kavali. Veellakemo rent kosam money kavali.

🛏️ So valla room lo air bed lu petti akkada stay chese daniki istharu money ki. Oka 3 members book cheskuntaru.. oka $1000 varaku osthadi.

💳 Stripe founders ki idea ela ochindante..

💻 Vallu first nunchi websites build chese vallu.. oka chinna startup kuda petti 5 million dollars ki ammesaru. Tarvatha inko idea build cheddam anukunte.. customers pay chese dantlo vallaki chala pedda problem ochindi..

⚙️ Servers ki easy ga Amazon AWS undi.. Code ki Github undi but payments ki matram chala problem face chestunnaru. So aa problem ne fix cheddam ani decide ayyaru.

🚕 Uber Story - Paris lo LeWeb tech conference attend ayye daniki potharu. Akkada vallaki Taxi chikkadu. So appudu idea osthadi.

📈 Growth Rate

🚀 YCombinator founder Paul Graham chepthadu.

📊 Once mee product launch chesina tarvatha.. mee startup successful avudda leda anedi decide chesedi Growth Rate.. last month tho compare cheste ee month entha mandi customers perigaru? Revenue entha perigindi?

📉 Adhi peruguthu potledu ante mee startup kuda peddadi avvadu.

🤔 And So meeru chudali idea baga leda leka marketing, distribution issue ah.. em cheyyali ani..

⚡ Execution Speed

🗣️ Sam Altman chepthadu

🚀 Startup successful avvali ante fast ga execute chese trait undali founders ki ani.

So slow🐌 undakudadu.🚫

🔥 Early Sacrifice Mandatory

💡 Bill Gates chepthadu starting stage lo weekends, holidays ila em undakudadu. Motham time startup kosame dedicate cheyyali.

⚔️ Lekapothe competitors will beat you.

🧠 Analysis Paralysis

🤔 Chala sarlu em cheyyalo ardham kadu.. confusion untadi..

⚡ Coinbase Founder Brian Armstrong - Action Produces Information antaru.

🚀 Samsara Founder Sanjit Biswas - maree ekkuva planning.. strategising cheyyakunda.. mundu action theeskondi. Tarvatha meerey nerchukuntaru em cheyyali em cheyyakudado antadu.
